## Section

## Severity
<!-- Pick one: `bug` | `friction` | `gap`
     bug      = instructions were wrong or contradictory
     friction = instructions worked but caused back-and-forth or guessing
     gap      = a scenario arose that wasn't covered at all -->


## Fingerprint
<!-- Deterministic dedup key: first 7 hex chars of
     sha1("severity|ultracode-goal/{stage}|skills/ultracode-goal/references/{stage}.md|section-slug|defect-key"),
     each as this issue writes it in Severity, Step File, Section and Defect Key.
     Auto-generated by the health-check workflow and also applied as an `fp-XXXXXXX` label.
     If you are filing this manually, compute it from the tuple above and include it here AND as a label;
     the dedup Action will link your report to any existing canonical issue.
     The section fingerprint is the same hash without "|defect-key": write it on the line below only, never
     as a label; the dedup Action reads it to flag open issues that may report the same defect under another key. -->
`fp-XXXXXXX`

Section fingerprint: `fp-XXXXXXX`

## Defect Key
<!-- One to four lower-case ASCII words joined by hyphens that name the thing the fix would change, in the stage
     reference's or the script's own words: the most specific script, subcommand, function, flag, field or rule the
     fix would edit, split at underscores, dots and case changes, leading dashes dropped (`gate_status` gives
     `gate-status`). For a missing rule, name the case it should cover in two to four of the stage reference's words,
     never the section's subject alone. Never a line number, file name, severity or words from your run's story. -->
